rows.question: How do refunds work?
rows.answer: Refunds are processed by the Admin through the billing module. To issue a refund, the admin searches for the member, clicks “Actions” and then “Payment History” to open the Transactions tab. From there they select Actions → “Refund Payment”, confirm the action, and a “Refund Successful” pop‑up appears. The refunded invoice is then listed under the “Refunded” tab. Note that refunding a payment does not automatically cancel an active (recurring) subscription; the member will continue to be billed until the subscription is manually canceled.

rows.question: How do I set up a payment gateway?
rows.answer: 1. Make sure you have an account with one of the supported payment gateways (see the Supported Payment Gateways list). 2. In the Brilliant Directories admin, go to **Finance » Payment Settings**. 3. Click the **Add New Payment Gateway** drop‑down and choose the gateway you want (Stripe, PayPal Standard, 2Checkout, PayPal Payments Pro, Authorize.net, etc.)【2】. 4. If you don’t already have an account with that gateway, create one now (Stripe and PayPal are the most common)【1】【2】. 5. After selecting the gateway, enter the required credentials (e.g., Stripe API keys) as shown in the setup guide and save the settings【4】【5】. Once saved, the gateway is connected and ready to process payments.

rows.question: Why are my member search results wrong?
rows.answer: Member search results can be incorrect for a few common reasons. For category searches, the member may have selected a different category than the one you searched for, causing unexpected members to appear in the results. For keyword searches, the keywords you entered might not match the members' indexed data or there may be other configuration issues that prevent expected members from showing up. Checking the member’s selected category and reviewing the keyword search settings are the first steps to troubleshoot these problems.

rows.question: How does distance sorting work in search results?
rows.answer: Distance sorting is applied only when the search term resolves to a specific point on a map (e.g., a city, zip/postal code, or street address). The system calculates each member’s distance from that searched location and orders the results from nearest to farthest. It does not sort by the visitor’s own physical location, and it is not used for broader searches such as state, country, province, or region names, which lack a precise latitude/longitude. For radius‑type location searches (the default for city and zip code searches), members are returned in order of distance from the searched location.

How do I enable predictive keyword search?
rows.answer: To enable Predictive Keyword Search, open the site’s Developers Tools, then click the **Autosuggest Settings** option. From there you can activate the add‑on and configure its rule settings – for example, select a **Class** (recommended) or ID, set the number of characters a visitor must type before suggestions appear, and define the maximum number of suggestions to show. Once the settings are saved, the auto‑suggest feature will be active on the site.

rows.question: Where do my social media links appear on the site?
rows.answer: Your social media links are displayed in the website’s footer menu (a row of icons under the “About” section). They can also appear in the header search area when the “Show Social Media Links” option is enabled in Design Settings.

rows.question: How do I connect my live domain for email accounts?
rows.answer: To enable email accounts you first need to connect your live domain. Open the Domain Manager (Settings → Domain tab), then click **Connect my domain name** (or **Change my domain name** if you already have one). Follow the four stages shown in the Domain Manager: 1) Choose an address, 2) Check it, 3) Point the domain (update the DNS records as shown), and 4) Switch over. Once the live domain is connected, the Manage Email Accounts page will no longer show the “Connect Live Domain” prompt and you can set up email accounts.

rows.question: How do I import categories with a CSV file?
rows.answer: 1. Create a CSV file that follows the Category Import template (it supports up to three tiers: top‑level, sub‑level and sub‑sub‑level categories). 2. In the admin, go to **Members >> Member Categories** and open the **Member Category Actions** menu, then choose **Import Categories**. 3. On the Import Settings page you can (optionally) check “Delete existing member top and sub level categories” if you want to start fresh (this will permanently remove current categories and unassign members). 4. Click **Choose File**, select your .csv file (not an Excel worksheet), and then click **Begin File Import**. The system will read the file and create the category structure.  (See sources for details.)

rows.question: How do I override the default CSS stylesheet?
rows.answer: To override the default stylesheet, go to Settings → Design Settings and open the Custom CSS / HEAD tab. Add your CSS rules to the Additional CSS editor (this field applies custom CSS to every page and overrides the template’s default CSS). Make sure the status line reads “CSS looks valid,” then click Save Changes. Deleting the CSS from this field will revert the site to the default styles.

rows.question: What access do I get with my Brilliant Directories license?
rows.answer: A Brilliant Directories license provides four main types of access: full access to the website’s database (so you can read, insert, update or delete records and build custom integrations)【1】; direct access to the cPanel account (email management, DNS zone editor, sub‑domains, additional database users, backups and other hosting tools)【3】; access to nearly all website widget code, which can be edited with PHP, HTML, CSS and JavaScript for custom functionality【5】; and lifetime software and security updates that keep the platform current without manual upgrades【2】.

rows.question: Does a refund cancel a member's subscription?
rows.answer: No, refunding a payment does not cancel the member's subscription; the subscription remains active and will continue to bill until manually canceled.
